evidence.snippet:
(row) => (
              <Card key={row.id}>
                <View style={[s.row, { justifyContent: "space-between" }]}>
                  <Label size={20} bold>
                    {row.name}
                  </Label>
                  <Badge>{enrollmentStatus[row.status]}</Badge>
                </View>
                <Label muted>
                  {formatDate(row.createdAt)} · {row.goals.join(", ")}
                </Label>
                <Label>
                  {row.email} · {row.phone}
                </Label>
                <View style={[s.row, { marginTop: 14 }]}>
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    onPress={() =>
                      void action(async () =>
                        setDetail(
                          await api<EnrollmentDetail>(
                            `/enrollment/requests/${row.id}`,
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    Ver ficha
                  </Button>
                  {row.status === "pending" && (
                    <>
                      <Button
                        disabled={busy}
                        onPress={() =>
                          void action(
                            () => change(row, "active"),
                            "Aluno aprovado.",
                          )
                        }
                      >
                        Aprovar
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="danger"
                        onPress={() =>
                          setConfirmation({
                            title: "Recusar cadastro",
                            description:
                              "A solicitação será marcada como recusada. Nenhuma conta será criada.",
                            run: () => change(row, "rejected"),
                          })
                        }
                      >
                        Recusar
                      </Button>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {row.status === "active" && (
                    <>
                      <Button variant="secondary" disabled={busy} onPress={()=>void action(()=>sendAccess(row))}>Enviar acesso pelo WhatsApp</Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="secondary"
                        onPress={() =>
                          router.push(`/alunos/${row.studentId}` as Href)
                        }
                      >
                        Abrir acompanhamento
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="danger"
                        onPress={() =>
                          setConfirmation({
                            title: "Desativar vínculo",
                            description:
                              "Seu acesso ao acompanhamento será encerrado. O histórico da conta do aluno será preservado.",
                            run: () => change(row, "inactive"),
                          })
                        }
                      >
                        Desativar vínculo
                      </Button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </View>
              </Card>
            )
